You learn the warning signs, set up your phone and accounts safely, and follow a clear plan for reporting to your bank, the police, the EFCC and the NCC.
Women of any education level who use a phone for money, business or family, especially traders, POS operators, job seekers and anyone supporting older relatives.
SEO: Search Engine Optimisation
Get a website and Google Business Profile found by the right customers, using Google's free tools and Google's own rules.

Learn how Google finds and ranks pages, research the words customers really search, optimise pages and Google Business Profiles, and measure results in Search Console. You finish with a full SEO audit and a 90-day content plan for a real Nigerian business.
Women who run, manage or support a small business or organisation website and want more customers to find it on Google.
Keep clear daily records of sales, expenses, stock, credit and cash in a notebook or on your phone, and use them to know your real profit.

A hands-on course for market traders and small business owners, including those with limited schooling. You will set up a simple notebook (or picture book) with a sales book, expenses page, stock cards, debtors list and cash book, then use them to calculate profit, plan stock and prepare for loans. Every lesson has worked examples in naira and a practice task you do in your own business.
Women market traders and small business owners in Nigeria and across Africa who want simple, practical records, whatever their level of schooling.
Turn local harvests like cassava, plantain, groundnuts and pepper into safe, labelled, shelf-stable products you can sell with confidence.

A practical course in processing Nigerian foods at home or small-workshop scale. You will learn the science of preservation, the WHO Five Keys and HACCP basics, drying, frying and storage, packaging and shelf-life testing, labelling and NAFDAC registration steps, and full costing. You finish with one documented batch and a 90-day plan.
Women who want to process local foods safely for family use, a side income or a growing small business, with basic reading and a smartphone.
Go from first touch to confident, safe everyday use of an Android smartphone for family, learning and earning.

A practical beginner course for women who are new to smartphones or use only a few features. You learn the phone's parts and settings, calls, SMS and WhatsApp, browsing and apps, the safety habits that protect your money and data, and how to use your phone to learn, earn and know your rights online.
Women in the WODDI network who are new to smartphones, or who use only calls and WhatsApp and want to use the phone safely and with confidence.
Soap Making for Small Business: Cold-Process Bars and Simple Liquid Soap
Make safe, correctly calculated, well-cured soap from local oils, then cost it, label it honestly and sell it.

A practical course for women who want to make and sell soap in Nigeria. You will handle caustic soda safely, calculate lye from SAP values and check it in SoapCalc, make cold-process bars and simple liquid soap, test and cure your products, and learn the basics of labelling, NAFDAC registration, costing and selling.
Women with no chemistry background who want to make quality soap at home or in a small workshop and sell it locally.
Plan, post, advertise and measure on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp so your social media brings real customers and sales.

A practical course for Nigerian and African small businesses. You will choose the right platforms, set up business profiles and Meta Business Suite, create posts and Reels that people respond to, run small paid ads with clear naira budgets, and measure what actually brings in sales. Every lesson ends with a task you complete for your own business.
Women running or starting small businesses who already use social media personally and want it to bring in customers.
Plan your week, run your home with simple systems, and protect your rest, even with a family and a business to manage.

A practical course for busy women who manage a home, children and work or a small business. You will audit where your time goes, prioritise with the Eisenhower matrix, plan weekly, set up routines, chore sharing, meal plans and a household budget, and protect your wellbeing with rest and boundaries.
Women, especially mothers and small business owners in Nigeria and across Africa, who want calmer days and a home that runs without them doing everything.
Training-of-Trainers (ToT): Teach Adults and Build Trainers
Design, deliver and evaluate practical trainings for women in your community, and prepare other women to train well too.

Learn how adults learn, how to design a training with ADDIE and SMART objectives, how to facilitate with participatory methods, and how to evaluate results with Kirkpatrick's four levels. You will finish with a tested training package, a ToT portfolio and a 90-day plan to cascade your training safely and with quality.
Women leaders, community mobilisers, cooperative and faith group coordinators, and experienced practitioners who want to teach what they know and prepare others to train.
Research real users, design and prototype a mobile flow in Figma, and prove it works through usability testing.

A practical introduction to user experience design using the methods professional teams use: design thinking, user interviews, personas, journey maps, information architecture, Figma wireframes, Nielsen's usability heuristics, WCAG accessibility basics and usability testing with five users. You will carry one real project from problem to tested prototype and finish with a case study you can show.
Women who are comfortable using smartphones and apps and want practical skills to design or improve digital products, websites or business booking flows.
Choose the right format and use your phone to send clear voice notes, photos and short videos that explain, prove, and tell your story.

A practical course for everyday communication with a smartphone. You learn when to type, speak, photograph or film, how to make each format clear, how to keep trustworthy records and family memories, and how to protect privacy and avoid spreading fake media. It is about clear personal, family, community and work messages, not social media marketing.
Women who use a smartphone every day and want their voice notes, photos and videos to be clearer, safer and more useful for family, community and work.
Set up WhatsApp safely, communicate clearly with family, groups and communities, and run a small business with WhatsApp Business tools.

A practical course on the real features of WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business, from installing and securing your account to groups, channels, communities, catalogues, quick replies and labels. Every lesson ends with a task on your own phone, and the course closes with a complete, scam-aware WhatsApp setup for your work or community.
Women who use a smartphone and want to communicate confidently, run community groups or sell products and services on WhatsApp.
Assess, secure and lead the security of a small organisation, from risk register to incident plan.

An advanced, practical course for women who look after the digital side of a business, NGO, school or community group. You will learn to classify threats, score risks, apply strong controls, respond to incidents in line with Nigeria's data protection law, and offer security reviews professionally.
Women who already use email, cloud tools and WhatsApp confidently and now manage or support the security of a team, business or organisation.
Detergent & Cleaning Products Production: A Six-Product Workshop
Run safe, recorded production batches of six household and institutional cleaning products, test and pack them properly, and price them for profit.

You will neutralise sulphonic acid into liquid laundry detergent, fill dish liquid by weight, find the right dose for a floor cleaner, and make a citric acid toilet gel, an ammonia-free glass cleaner and a BKC disinfectant cleaner, then release each batch against a test card, pack it in the right container and cost it to the bottle.
Women with no chemistry background who want to produce and sell cleaning products in a small workshop and supply homes, shops and institutions.
Choose the right online income model, work reliably with clients across time zones, get paid safely and launch a digital service with a 90-day plan.

A practical course for women who want to earn through remote jobs, freelancing, online selling or digital products from Nigeria. You will build a work-ready setup with backups, learn the written and tool habits remote clients expect, receive cross-border payments safely, and finish with a launched service and a measurable 90-day plan.
Women with a marketable skill and basic smartphone or computer confidence who want to earn reliably from clients and employers beyond their local area.
Map, assess and improve how an organisation handles personal data under Nigeria's Data Protection Act 2023, and advise others to do the same.

An advanced, practical course on responsible handling of personal data in Nigerian and African organisations. You learn the NDPA 2023 principles and lawful bases, build a data inventory, score risks, run DPIAs, handle rights requests and breaches, and write plain-language privacy notices. The course ends with a full audit and policy project you can use as a portfolio piece.
Women who handle customer, member, student or staff data at work, or who want to advise small businesses, schools and NGOs on data protection.
Rank your real local hazards, build a tested household plan and kit, and lead your community through warning, response and safer recovery.

A practical course for women who hold households and communities together when floods, fires, windstorms or droughts strike. You will use Nigerian forecasts and local memory to rank your risks, build and test a kit, plan and phone tree, and learn safe first steps and build-back-better recovery.
Women who manage households, small businesses or community groups in flood-, fire- or drought-prone areas and want to lead practical preparedness.
Export Readiness (Selected Products): From Local Seller to First Export Shipment
Prepare one product you already make, such as dried ginger, hibiscus or adire, for a foreign buyer with the right paperwork, label, price and shipment plan.

A hands-on advanced course for producers who already sell locally and want to export one selected product. Women producers who already sell a product consistently in Nigeria and want to prepare it for buyers in another country.
Plan, power, zone and staff a small production workshop that is safe, organised and sized to your real orders.

An advanced, practical course for producers moving from a home corner to a dedicated workshop. Women already producing goods for sale who want to set up or reorganise a small dedicated workshop or production room.
Read fit, alter bodices, trousers, sleeves, necklines and gowns accurately, restyle old garments and price every job by the time it really takes.

A practical alterations course for women who already sew basic seams and hems. You will learn to read fit and ease, run a proper fitting, calculate exactly how much a garment can be taken in or let out, and carry out the alterations clients ask for most, from tapered trousers to lined aso-ebi gowns. The course ends with restyling projects and a working system for intake, scheduling and time-based pricing.
Women who can already use a sewing machine and sew simple seams and hems, and want to earn from alterations and restyling.
Fashion Business Management: Production Operations for Scaling
Turn a busy tailoring practice into a managed workroom with timed operations, minute costing, quality gates and a 90-day growth plan.

An advanced, hands-on course for fashion business owners who already sew and sell. You measure where your hours go, standardise your styles with operation sheets and golden samples, run a job board with WIP limits and quality gates, cost garments by the minute, and grow through boutiques, contracts and a fairly paid team.
Women who already run a tailoring or fashion business with at least one helper and want to produce more, to a steady standard, without sewing every piece themselves.
Finish hems, collars, closures, linings and details to boutique standard, and prove it with a written quality check before every handover.

This hands-on course teaches the construction techniques behind clean hems, crisp collars and cuffs, hidden zips, secure closures, well-fitted linings and lasting decorative details, then gives you a written inspection, correction and handover system you can use on every order.
Women who can already sew basic garments and want their finishing and quality checks to match boutique and ready-to-wear standards.
Measure your financial position, master interest and credit, protect what you build and follow a written personal financial plan.

A practical course in personal financial management for women in Nigeria and across Africa. You build your own net worth and cash flow statements, learn the arithmetic behind interest, inflation and loans, use credit and insurance wisely, secure your financial independence and finish with a Personal Financial Management Plan and a 90-day action path.
Adult women who already handle household or business money and want a clear, structured way to measure, protect and grow their finances.
Fintech Fundamentals: How Digital Finance Works in Africa
Explain, analyse and evaluate African fintech products, from payment rails and lending to remittances, and turn that knowledge into a fintech role or service.

An advanced, practical course on how digital payments, wallets, lending, savings and remittances really work in Nigeria and across Africa. You trace money through the rails, calculate true costs and business metrics, check licences and fraud controls, and finish with a professional case study and a 90-day plan.
Women who already use digital money and want to understand the fintech sector well enough to work in it, advise others or build with it.
Keep food safe for longer at home and in a small shop by drying, salting, smoking, fermenting, pickling, making jam, and using cold and dry storage the right way.

You will learn why food spoils, the WHO Five Keys and botulism rules, and then practise drying, salting, smoking, fermenting, pickling and jam making, before mastering fridge and freezer use through power cuts, stock rotation and honest pricing.
Women who cook for a household or run a small food shop or provisions stall in Nigeria and want to waste less food and sell their surplus safely.
Take control of your phone's settings, use free Google tools for real tasks, keep your device safe and fix everyday problems on your own.

A practical, phone-first course for women who use WhatsApp and calls but want to do much more with their smartphone. You will manage data and settings, move information between apps, use Maps, Lens, Keep, Calendar and Sheets for real household and business tasks, protect your phone against loss and theft, and solve common problems yourself. You finish by teaching a skill to another woman and writing your own 90-day plan.
Women who already make calls and use WhatsApp on an Android smartphone (iPhone users can follow most lessons) and want to use it confidently for family, community and small business tasks.
Understand how GM crops are made, weigh the real evidence on safety, environment and cost, and lead calm, accurate conversations about GMOs in your community.

An advanced literacy course on genetic modification for African women who farm, feed families or lead groups. You learn the biology behind GM crops, how WHO and Codex approach food safety, the real environmental and economic questions, and how Nigeria's National Biosafety Management Agency regulates GMOs. You finish with a country brief, a fully evaluated claim and a community outreach plan.
Women farmers, cooperative and group leaders, teachers, health workers and food traders who want accurate, balanced knowledge of GMOs to guide their own decisions and their communities.
Growth Marketing: Funnels, Experiments and Sustainable Growth
Find where a business loses customers, test fixes with fair experiments, and turn honest results into growth and paid consulting work.

An advanced, practical course for marketers and business owners who already know digital marketing basics. You will map AARRR funnels, calculate unit economics, design and prioritise experiments, check results for statistical significance, and package audits, proposals and case studies for clients in Nigeria and beyond.
Women with basic digital marketing experience who want to grow their own business or offer growth marketing to start-ups and small brands.
Hair Care & Simple Styling: Salon Service Practice
Deliver safe, timed and fairly priced braiding and twisting services to paying clients, from consultation to the hygiene reset.

A hands-on course for women who can already do basic hair and want to serve clients professionally. You practise hair and scalp assessment, consultations, washing and stretching, parting grids, knotless and feed-in braids, flat twists and African threading, with tension control to prevent traction alopecia. You finish with a between-client hygiene routine, a timing log and a cost-based price menu.
Women in Nigeria and across Africa who braid for family or neighbours and want to offer safe, organised, paid salon services at home or in a small shop.
Block the routes germs use to reach your family, using clean hands, safe water, clean toilets, a hygienic kitchen and safe waste habits, and turn those skills into a paid service.

A practical course on keeping a Nigerian home clean and safe, built on WHO guidance. The course ends with first aid, knowing when to seek care, and pricing a cleaning or hygiene service.
Women managing a household or compound, and anyone who wants to offer cleaning or hygiene services, with no previous training needed.
Know what you stand for, lead groups fairly and confidently, and deliver a small, real project that improves your community.

A practical course for women who already lead in homes, groups and neighbourhoods, often without the title. You will clarify your identity and values, take a skills baseline, learn to run meetings and inclusive decisions, track your growth, and plan and document a costed community project with real stakeholders.
Women in Nigeria and across Africa who want to lead more confidently in their household, groups, community or civic life, whatever their level of schooling.
Formulate, test, label and sell a complete liquid hygiene range, from mild hand wash and shampoo to fabric softener, surface cleaners and correctly diluted disinfectants.

Women who already make bar or basic liquid soap and want to build a full, professional liquid hygiene product range for homes, salons and institutions.
Measure marketing across every channel, reconcile the numbers with real sales, and write reports that lead to clear budget decisions.

An advanced, practical course for women who already do digital marketing and want to prove what works. You finish with a priced analytics offer and a 90-day plan to win clients.
Women who already run or support digital marketing for a business or clients and want to measure, report and sell analytics confidently.

A practical course, based on World Health Organization guidance, on antenatal and postnatal care, birth planning, newborn and child danger signs, and the prevention habits that protect children. Women and caregivers, pregnant or not, who want to protect mothers and children in their family and community, with no medical background needed.
Plan, build, test and hand over a working business app on Google AppSheet, and price it as paid client work.

You then test, secure and document it, and learn to run discovery, price projects and plan your first 90 days of no-code client work.
Women with solid spreadsheet and smartphone skills who want to build internal business apps for their own work, employers or paying clients.
Plan, build, track and manage Google Ads campaigns that turn search intent into measurable leads, and price that work for clients.

An advanced, practical course on Google Ads for service businesses in Nigeria and abroad. You learn how the auction works, how to work out what a click is worth, how to build and track a search campaign properly, and how to audit, price and win client accounts.
Women who already understand basic digital marketing and want to manage Google Ads professionally for local or international clients.
Plan, track, test and manage profitable Facebook and Instagram campaigns in Ads Manager, and turn the skill into paid client work.

An advanced course for people who already post and boost on Facebook and Instagram and want to run Meta Ads professionally. You will set targets from real unit economics, set up the Meta Pixel and Conversions API, build audiences, run clean A/B tests, protect accounts from policy and scam risks, and price, propose and document client work.
Women who already sell or post on Facebook and Instagram, or have taken a social media marketing course, and want to manage Meta Ads for their own business or for clients.
Measure what you lose after harvest, fix your biggest loss point with proven low-cost storage, handling and preservation methods, and prove the result with your own numbers.

A practical course for women who grow, store, process or trade food. Women farmers, traders and small processors in Nigeria and across Africa who want to lose less of the food they grow, buy or sell.
Power BI and Tableau: Interactive Business Dashboards
Turn messy business data into trustworthy, interactive dashboards in Power BI or Tableau, and price and deliver them professionally.

You will model data as a star schema, write correct measures in DAX and Tableau calculated fields, clean data with repeatable steps, design and test interactive dashboards, and then scope, price and present dashboard work for clients or employers.
Women who are comfortable with spreadsheets (formulas, sorting, simple charts) and want to build professional dashboards for employers, NGOs or paying clients.
Discover what users really need, prioritise with clear reasoning, and hand a development team work they can build right the first time.

Women working in or near digital products, such as analysts, support leads, designers, operations staff and founders, who want to lead product decisions with evidence.

Producers of food, cosmetics, crafts or garments who sell regularly and want to supply shops, hotels, distributors or other larger buyers.

Women producers in Nigeria and across Africa who already sell a product regularly and want to supply shops, institutions or distributors at higher volume.

Women who already use AI tools at work or in business and want reliable, checkable results and the ability to train others.
Remote Work & Team Collaboration: Leading Distributed Teams

An advanced, practical course for women who lead, coordinate or advise teams spread across cities and countries. You will set up async-first working agreements, a shared workspace, status updates, decision records and meetings that produce results, then audit a real team, scope an improvement project and build your own accountability system and evidence portfolio.
Women who coordinate, lead or support teams, volunteer networks or clients across locations and want to do it professionally, including those preparing for remote team lead or operations roles.
Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Professional Audits and Client Practice
Audit a real website like a professional, prioritise fixes with evidence, prove results and sell SEO services with confidence.

An advanced, practical course for women who already know SEO basics and want to work as SEO consultants or in-house specialists. You will size opportunities from real data, diagnose technical problems in Google's own terms, run evidence-based audits and turn them into client-ready reports, proposals and a 90-day plan for winning clients.
Women who understand SEO basics (keywords, on-page SEO, Search Console) and want to deliver professional SEO audits and services to local, multi-country or international clients.

Women who have made soap at home, or completed a basic soap course, and want to produce laundry and bath soap in quantity for sale.

Women who are comfortable with spreadsheets or basic computing and want practical SQL for reporting, analysis, a data role or freelance work.
Find, compare, check and plan your materials so production never stops for want of supply.

Women who already produce goods such as food, drinks, cosmetics, garments or crafts and want reliable, well-priced materials as they scale up.
Sustainable Agriculture Practices: Healthy Soil, Smart Water and Climate-Ready Farming
Test your own soil and water, put proven low-cost practices to work, and prove with your own records that your land is getting healthier.

Women who already farm a plot or field in Nigeria or elsewhere in Africa and want to stop soil decline, cope with erratic rain and cut input costs.

Women who already understand basic UX (flows and wireframes) and want to produce professional, developer-ready interface designs for clients or employers.
UX Design Fundamentals: Professional Practice
Diagnose, measure and fix real usability problems, then sell and lead UX work with evidence a client or team will trust.

An advanced, practice-heavy course for people who already know the basic UX process and want to work at a professional level. Women who have completed an introductory UX course or work near digital products and want to offer UX audits, research and design leadership professionally.

Women who already build simple websites or designs and want to offer professional Webflow development to local and international clients.

For women who already sell something and want a stronger, more profitable business.
